key_insight: AbsorbEvo turns natural-language absorber targets into autonomous candidate design, ranking, and simulation loops that combine LLM reasoning with physics-guided prediction and feedback.
engineering_relevance: The framework could substantially reduce expert effort and search time for microwave absorber inverse design while keeping final candidates grounded in full-wave electromagnetic simulation.
method: LLM proposes parameter adjustment directions and magnitudes from the task objective and search history.
A low-cost predictive model acts as a physics prior to rank globally sampled and incrementally evolved candidates.
Top-ranked designs are validated by full-wave simulation, and successful skills are distilled into reusable text instructions.
evidence_signal: On AbsorbBench-36, AbsorbEvo reached a 79.17% task success rate and 0.7816 mean best coverage, outperforming a generic agent and random search under the same proposal budget.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the predictive prior, physical validity checks, and task-specific skill transfer, so robustness outside the benchmark and to new absorber families remains to be verified.
paper_title: AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers
